questions.question: Brazen can paint a wall red in 12 days, while Ballary can paint the entire wall in 21 days. If Brazen and Ballari work alternately for one day each from painting the wall to coloring it red, then how many days will it take to paint the entire wall red?
questions.solution:
**Given:

Brazen can paint a wall in 12 days

Ballary can paint the wall in 21 days

**Formula used:**

If a person can complete the work in A days, then the person can complete 1/A work in 1 day.

Calculation:**

Work completed by Brazen in 1 day = 1/12

Work completed by Ballary in 1 day = 1/21

Total work completed by them in 1 day = 1/12 + 1/21

⇒ Total work completed by them in 2 days = (7 + 4)/84

⇒ Total work completed by them in 2 days = 11/84

Total work completed by them in 7 × 2 days = 14 days = 77/84 

⇒ Remaining work = 1 – 77/84 = 7/84 = 1/12

Brazen can do 1/12 work in 1 day

Total time taken = 14 + 1 = 15 days

**∴ Total time taken is 15 days**

questions.question: How many factors of 2⁸ × 3² × 5³ × 7⁵ are even numbers?
questions.solution:

A given natural number can be expressed as 2a.3b.5c.7d...... and so on 

Where a, b, c, d ...... and so on are whole numbers

Total number of even factors = a × (b + 1) × (c + 1) × (d + 1) ...... and so on

**∴ Total numbers of even factors is 576**

questions.question: If the momentum of an object increases by 20%, its kinetic energy will increase by ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**44%.**__

__
 
• **Momentum** can be defined as the** product** of the** mass of a particle and its velocity.**
 
• It is denoted by** p**, SI unit is** (Kg-m)/s** and Dimension is ** MLT−¹.**
 
• **Newton's second law** defines a** force** to be equal to the **change in momentum with a change in time. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

If** **Initial Momentum** **=** pᵢ, **Mass of object =** m, **and velocity of object =** v **

**Kinetic Energy**,** K.Eᵢ** **= 1/2 (mv²) **

1/2 (mv2) = (1/2 (mv)²)/m = (1/2p²)/m

Now, **p increases by 20%** , so new momentum,

**pf** =( p + 20% of p) = p + p/5 = **6p/5.**

New Kinetic Energy = (1/2pf2)/m.

So,** K.Ef **= (1/2 * (6p/5)²)/m = 36/25 * (1/2p2)/m.

**% increase in K.E** = **(Change in K.E/ Initial K.E) * 100**

 =( ( 36/25 * (1/2p2)/m - (1/2p2)/m) / (1/2p2)/m) * 100.

So, % increase in K.E = (11/25) * 100 =** 44%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

**K.E = 1/2 (mv2)** = 1/2 (mv)*v.

K.E = **1/2(pv)**, ---------- 1

But the above equation is** wrong to implement** in this question.

 
• Since p = m*v, where** mass is always constant**, and **velocity varies**, which means momentum varies because of the velocity.
 
• In **eqn. 1**,** v is left out**, and hence the** result** thus produced **will be wrong.**

questions.question: A train traveling at a speed of 66 km/hr crosses a 465 m long bridge in 33 seconds. How long was the train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of train = 66 km/hr

Length of bridge = 465 m

Time taken to cross the bridge = 33 sec

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the length of the train = x m

Distance covered by the train = length of train + length of bridge

⇒ Distance = (x + 465) m

As, Distance = Speed × Time

x + 465 = [66 × (5/18)] × 33

⇒ x + 465 = 605 

⇒ x = 605 – 465 = 140 m

**∴ Length of the train is 140 m**

questions.question: The ratio of the present ages of X and Y is 3 : 8 while the ratio of the present ages of Y and Z is 4 : 5. Two years ago the age ratio of X and Y was 1 : 3. What is the sum of the present ages of the three?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the present ages of X and Y is 3 : 8

The ratio of the present ages of Y and Z is 4 : 5

Two years ago the age ratio of X and Y was 1 : 3

**Concept Used:**

Concept of ratio and proportion

**Calculation****:**

Let, the present age of X and Y be 3p and 8p respectively. [Where p is a constant]

Two years ago the age of X was (3p - 2)

Two years ago the age of Y was (8p - 2)

Accordingly,

{(3p - 2) over (8p - 2)} = {1 over 3}

⇒ 3 × (3p - 2) = (8p - 2)

⇒ 9p - 6 = 8p - 2

⇒ 9p - 8p = - 2 + 6

⇒ p = 4

The present age of X is (3 × 4) = 12 years

The present age of Y is (8 × 4) = 32 years

The ratio of the present ages of Y and Z is 4 : 5

Let, the present age of Y and Z are 4q and 5q respectively. [Where q is a constant]

Accordingly,

4q = 32

⇒ q = 8

The present age of Z is (5 × 8) = 40 years

Sum of their present age is (12 + 32 + 40) = 84 years

**∴ The sum of the present ages of the three is 84 years.**

questions.question: A cyclist covers the first three kilometers at an average speed of 8 km/h, the other two kilometers at 3 km/h and the last two kilometers at 2 km/h. What is the approximate average speed (in km/h) of the entire journey?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of cyclist in first 3 km = 8 km/h

Speed of cyclist in next 2 km = 3 km/h

Speed of cyclist in last 2 km = 2 km/h

**Formula used:**

(i) Speed = Distance/Time

(ii) Average speed = (Total distance travelled)/(Total time taken)

**Calculations:**

Average speed = (3 + 2 + 2)/{(3/8) + (2/3) + (2/2)}

⇒ 7/{(9 + 16 + 24)/24}

⇒ 7/(49/24)

⇒ (7 × 24)/49

⇒ 3.43 km/h

**∴ The approximate average speed of the entire journey is 3.43 km/h.**
